summary: Backend API testing completed for Manthan Leadership Development Program. Found and fixed critical bug where ADMIN_API_KEY was not being loaded correctly due to import order issue. All 26 tests now passing.

critical.issue: ADMIN_API_KEY not loaded correctly - load_dotenv() was called AFTER importing admin_routes.py, causing the API key to use default value instead of .env value

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: server.py - load_dotenv() must be called BEFORE importing modules that use environment variables (admin_routes.py, public_routes.py)
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ is created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend admin and public routes are working correctly. API key authentication requires X-API-Key header with value 'manthan_admin_secure_2025'. MongoDB collections: programs, testimonials, contacts. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_manthan_api.py covers all CRUD operations.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In server.py, admin_routes.py was imported on line 10, but load_dotenv() was called on line 15. When admin_routes.py was imported, it read ADMIN_API_KEY from os.environ which was empty, so it used the default value 'manthan_admin_2025' instead of the .env value 'manthan_admin_secure_2025'.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Moved load_dotenv() call to line 11 (before importing admin_routes and public_routes)
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 26 backend tests now pass with correct API key authentication
